schema_gaps: The registry does not say which record types may be created from a document: `source` is prose. extract_schema matches document-like words in it (SOURCE_WORDS) and adds the types an origin link lets start in a document.

No origin link exists for an entity made from a document (Person, Group, Position, Role, Organization, Service, Topic, EmailAddress): EXTRACTED_FROM, RAISED_IN and MADE_IN start only at knowledge types. Used instead: Piece -MENTIONS-> the record (kind name), which the registry allows to any type. A document with no Pieces has nothing to cite it from, so no new entity is made from it (counted).
MADE_IN cannot end at a Piece (Decision -> Document, File, DocSection ...): a decision's origin is its document, with the quoted piece as evidence.

DECIDED_BY, ASSIGNED_TO, ASKED_BY and AUTHORED_BY end at Account, Alias or EmailAddress, never Person; HOLDS_POSITION and REPORTS_TO start at Person only. A name known only as the other kind is followed through its identity links when there is exactly one, else the link is skipped and counted.
Claim, Convention, Incident and Handover can originate in a document but have no name or text field, so a text cannot state one: not extracted.
A DocSection may attach only to a File or another DocSection, never to a Document (a wiki page): wiki sections arrive as Pieces whose heading is the section path.
Document extraction quality (kept ratio) has no field on File or Document: it is read from the graph's report.json (doc_quality) and multiplied into confidence.

No link joins two Requirements other than SUPERSEDES: DEPENDS_ON and LINKS_TO do not start at a Requirement, and ABOUT, which starts at any type, does not end at one. A requirement citing another one by id is written as the citing requirement's passage (Piece) LINKS_TO the cited Requirement (LINKS_TO ends at any type); a Requirement -> Requirement reference link would carry it directly (extract_facts.link_cited_ids picks one up as soon as the registry has it).

No link with a count joins a Person or Account to a Service, Repository or Folder (KNOWS_ABOUT has an order, EDITED_BY a count but starts at a File or Piece): a table of commit counts per person and module cannot store its counts. Such a table's mapping names the gap (schema_gap) and the table is read as text as well.
